name: school-games-telemetry
description: Anonymous play statistics for the school games portal, with the insights dashboard: a Cloudflare Worker on a free D1 database, or Node on one SQLite file.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: The password for the insights dashboard. Make one up: at least 16 English letters or digits, with no spaces. Write it down: you type it to open the dashboard, and Cloudflare keeps it secret and cannot show it to you again (it can only be replaced).

DB.description: The database that keeps the anonymous play totals. Keep the suggested name; Cloudflare creates it for you.
